# Generated by scripts/generate_elections.py

eu4_2k_clear_ruling_bloc = {
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_left
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_centre_left
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_liberal
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_centre_right
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_national_conservative
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_coalition
}

eu4_2k_clear_opposition_bloc = {
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_left
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_left
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_liberal
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_right
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_national_conservative
	clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_coalition
}

# The governing bloc stays in office or the previous one becomes the opposition.
eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_left = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_left }
		change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		eu4_2k_clear_opposition_bloc = yes
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_left } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_left }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_centre_left } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_left }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_liberal } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_liberal }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_centre_right } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_right }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_national_conservative } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_national_conservative }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_coalition } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_coalition }
		eu4_2k_clear_ruling_bloc = yes
		set_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_left
		set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 1 }
	}
}

eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_coalition = {
	if = {

		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_centre_right } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_right }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_national_conservative } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_national_conservative }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_coalition } set_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_coalition }

eu4_2k_opposition_takes_power = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_left }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_left = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_left }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_centre_left = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_liberal }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_liberal = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_centre_right }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_centre_right = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_national_conservative }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_national_conservative = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_opposition_coalition }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_coalition = yes
	}
}

eu4_2k_surge_takes_power = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_bloc_national_conservative }
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_left = yes
	}
	else = {
		eu4_2k_bloc_takes_power_national_conservative = yes
	}
}

# The campaign event opens three months before the next election.
eu4_2k_schedule_next_election = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_election_cycle_5 }
		country_event = { id = eu4_2k_elections.1 days = 1736 }
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = eu4_2k_elections.1 days = 1371 }
	}
}

# Used when a country becomes a competitive democracy after the start.
eu4_2k_begin_competitive_politics = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_competitive_politics } }
		set_country_flag = eu4_2k_competitive_politics
		eu4_2k_schedule_next_election = yes
	}
}
